text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Wow, the audience is so loud. And<n>they're all
looking at me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I see you all too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I can see every single one of your<n>smiles!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't have done it without<n>everyone
cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you... from the bottom... of my<n>heart!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, Rice Shower gave the<n>performance of her
life in the ultimate<n>race—a feat that's brought a
smile to<n>everyone's face.
